runs.label: Original: 1 replica × 1 worker
runs.description: Single Flask process behind nginx, shared Redis counter.

recovery_detail.note: 3 of 7 gateway probes failed during the restart; the first healthy response after the last failure arrived 0.453s after injection.

runs.label: Two stateless replicas × 1 worker
runs.description: Second identical app replica behind nginx; Redis remains shared.

recovery_detail.note: No gateway-level outage observed: another replica served traffic while web-1 restarted.

runs.label: One replica × 2 gunicorn workers
runs.description: More in-process workers on a single replica; Redis unchanged.

recovery_detail.note: 6 of 10 gateway probes failed during the restart; the first healthy response after the last failure arrived 0.546s after injection.

note: Each run deployed a DARWIN-owned isolated Compose stack on loopback. The repository Compose file and Dockerfile were not used. Latency, throughput and recovery were measured live; simulation never wins.
